entries.zh: 这里有一些{i0}，想要就拿去。

entries.en: @item.base:This helmet when worn grants vision even in complete darkness
entries.zh: 戴上这顶头盔，即使在完全的黑暗中也能视物

entries.en: @item.base:This intricately designed and articulated arm harness looks cumbersome, but undoubtedly effective
entries.zh: 这套整臂甲设计精巧，关节结构复杂。看起来十分笨重，但防护无疑可靠

entries.en: @item.base:This large two-handed mace looks to be made of brass, but is deceptively light and features a fairly keen spike
entries.zh: 这把大型双手钉头锤看似黄铜制成，却出奇地轻巧，还带有一根相当锋利的尖刺

entries.en: @item.base:This mace has large flanges that form a hollow space lined with strange decorative elements
entries.zh: 这把钉头锤的大型凸缘围成了一个中空空间，内壁饰有奇异的装饰

entries.en: @item.base:This ornate battle axe is seemingly made largely of a brassy metal, but it's not as heavy as it looks
entries.zh: 这把华丽的战斧似乎主要由黄铜色金属制成，却没有看上去那么重

entries.en: @item.base:This sword feels lighter than it looks and its balance shifts as you move it. This feels strange at first but you can see how it could be used to great effect
entries.zh: 这把剑比看上去更轻，而且在挥动时，平衡点也会随之变化。起初感觉很奇怪，但你能看出这种特性能发挥很大作用

entries.en: @item.base:This sword has a very unusual and intricate construction, and yet appears to still make an effective weapon
entries.zh: 这把剑的构造极其独特而复杂，却似乎仍是一件实用的武器

entries.en: @item.base:When you wear this helm you are able to make out your surroundings even in complete darkness
entries.zh: 戴上这顶头盔后，即使身处完全的黑暗，你也能辨认周围的事物

entries.en: @item.base:When you wear this strange helmet you feel a strong sense of quiet and isolation
entries.zh: 戴上这顶奇异的头盔时，你会感到强烈的宁静，仿佛与世隔绝

entries.en: @item.base:breastplate. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 胸甲。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:cuirass combining metal and a tough, light material
entries.zh: 一副将金属与坚韧轻巧的材料结合而成的躯干甲

entries.en: @item.base:cuirass made from a very tough and light material
entries.zh: 一副由极其坚韧轻巧的材料制成的躯干甲
一把设计独特、带有装饰的长柄战斧

entries.en: @item.base:extremely solid looking suit of armour that completely encases the body. It seems as though it should make movement extremely difficult
entries.zh: 一套看起来极为坚固的护甲，将全身严密包裹。穿着它行动似乎会非常困难

entries.en: @item.base:fake crown such as is used in the production of plays
entries.zh: 用于戏剧演出的假王冠

entries.en: @item.base:heavy ornate armour made from a brass like metal. Various shield like elements appear to float and move with the armour without being attached to it
entries.zh: 一套沉重华丽的护甲，由类似黄铜的金属制成。许多盾状部件并未与护甲连接，却仿佛悬浮在周围，随护甲一同移动

entries.en: @item.base:heavy ornate helm made from a brass like metal. When worn it provides vision in darkness
entries.zh: 一顶沉重而华丽的头盔，由类似黄铜的金属制成，戴上后可以在黑暗中视物
一柄镶嵌着宝石的大型华丽长矛

entries.en: @item.base:leather vest. Clearly this was designed for women
entries.zh: 皮背心，显然是为女性设计的

entries.en: @item.base:one and a half handed sword that bears a decoration resembling a sun on the guard
entries.zh: 一把手半剑，护手上带有形似太阳的装饰

entries.en: @item.base:ornate mace made entirely of some metal similar to brass
entries.zh: 一把华丽的钉头锤，通体由某种类似黄铜的金属制成

entries.en: @item.base:ornate sceptre holding what seem to be very large gemstones. When you hold it you feel as though your mind can focus on more things at once
entries.zh: 一柄华丽的权杖，上面镶着似乎极为硕大的宝石。握住它时，你觉得自己的心神仿佛能同时专注于更多事物

entries.en: @item.base:pair of boots. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 一双靴子。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:pair of couters. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 一对护肘。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:pair of cuisses. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 一对大腿甲。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:pair of gauntlets made with metal and a softer but very tough material
entries.zh: 一对由金属和较柔软但极其坚韧的材料制成的护手

entries.en: @item.base:pair of plate gauntlets made from a brassy metal
entries.zh: 一对板甲护手，由黄铜色金属制成

entries.en: @item.base:pair of spaulders. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 一对肩甲。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:pair of vambraces. Metal bands cover a tough and light material
entries.zh: 一对前臂甲。金属带覆盖着一种坚韧而轻巧的材料

entries.en: @item.base:plate armour. It is made from a metal similar to brass, but while heavy, it serves its purpose well
entries.zh: 板甲。它由一种类似黄铜的金属制成，虽重，却能提供良好的防护

entries.en: @item.base:plate cuirass made from a strange brassy metal that's heavier than normal, but still effective
entries.zh: 一副由奇异黄铜色金属制成的板甲躯干甲，比普通护甲更重，但防护依然可靠

entries.en: @item.base:primitive looking and oddly proportioned sword with a needlessly thick blade
entries.zh: 这把剑外形粗陋，比例古怪，剑身厚得毫无必要

entries.en: @item.base:spiked mace with a large hollow head
entries.zh: 一把带有大型中空锤头的尖刺钉头锤

entries.en: @item.base:very peculiar two-handed sword that would seem ornamental, and yet quite functional
entries.zh: 一把十分奇特的双手剑，看似装饰品，却颇为实用

entries.en: @item.base:visored helm made from a metal similar to brass, but not as heavy as you expect
entries.zh: 一顶带面甲的头盔，由类似黄铜的金属制成，却没有想象中那么重

entries.en: @item.base:wide bracelet that clamps tightly about the wrist. You feel a strange tingling sensation when you wear it
entries.zh: 宽手镯，紧紧箍住手腕。戴上时，你会感到一种奇异的麻刺感

entries.en:
The label on this bottle reads:
[algn=2][scrp=i][tcol=FFF1CC]
Nephil's Elixir of Warding
[/tcol]
Wards against and soothes pain, whether it be of tooth, of joint or any ailment or injury. It may cause a mild drowsiness.
[scrp=n][algn=0]

The bottle is empty.
entries.zh:
瓶上的标签写着：
[algn=2][scrp=i][tcol=FFF1CC]
奈菲尔护佑灵药
[/tcol]
预防并缓解疼痛，无论牙痛、关节痛，还是疾病与外伤引起的疼痛。服用后可能略感困倦。
[scrp=n][algn=0]

瓶子是空的。

entries.zh: 罐内的黏稠物质散发着微光，气味刺鼻，却莫名地令人想要靠近。

entries.en: There is a faintly glowing residue in this jar.
entries.zh: 罐里残留着一些微微发光的物质。
